notes:
Mid-market product analytics vendor building embedded assistant and search features. Started on Hosted API (trial) to validate prompts; now pushing to Dedicated for predictable throughput + data isolation. AE/SE conversations focused on: predictable p95 latency, cost per unit, and KMS/Audit integration. Customer quote: "Hosted was great to iterate but we need dedicated capacity for peak product traffic and residency controls."

POC ask summary: 2-week Dedicated POC with canary rollout. Primary workload: conversational in-product assistant + semantic search for support docs. Targets: 95th pct latency < 250ms for assistant, baseline throughput 100-150 qps, cost sensitivity (wants predictability; target ARR economics aligned to $150k-$400k commit). Model preference: prefer open Llama-family or redwood-verified variants; willing to test quantized models for cost if quality delta < 4% on intent accuracy.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for console access, KMS for key management (customer-managed if possible), audit logging and 12-month retention for logs. Data residency: initial POC in us-west1, production could require us-east and eu-west failover but no EU-only tenancy for now.

Commercials: asked for pricing comparison between Hosted vs Dedicated (committed monthly) — wants example TCO slides (drive link). Finance needs a 2-up internal deck for procurement by end of March.

Technical notes: SE ran a spike on batching and saw 2x cost improvement with prefix caching; requested guidance from Redwood Optimize on batching and quantization profile. Customer will run automated evals (intent accuracy + hallucination checks) daily during POC using their eval harness.

Next-steps in notes: schedule POC kickoff (calendar invite), share POC runbook + SSO/KMS integration checklist, confirm failover region and rollback criteria, legal to finish data processing addendum.

poc_summary: 2-week Dedicated POC focused on in-product assistant + semantic search. Goals: validate latency SLOs, throughput, rollback/runbook, and cost profile. Canary to receive ~5-10% production traffic, monitored for quality regressions and performance. If canary meets SLOs, plan staged ramp to 50% then 100%.
canary_plan: Deploy Dedicated cluster (us-west1) with model variant: redwood-v1-8b-quant (canary)
Traffic split: start 5% -> monitor 48 hours -> 10% for 24h -> evaluate; ramp on pass
Monitoring: p95 latency, token/sec, error rate, end-to-end intent accuracy via eval harness
Quality gates: no >5% drop in intent accuracy, no increase >1.5x error rate, p95 latency <250ms
Rollback criteria: any critical errors, sustained latency breach >30 mins, or quality drop >5% triggers automatic rollback to previous model/version
fallback_routing: Model fallback: if canary model degrades, route to redwood-stable-7b (slower but reliable)
Region failover: active in us-west1, automatic failover to us-east1 if node-level outage detected >90s
Tiered capacity fallback: prefer Dedicated -> fallback to Hosted API routes for <10% degraded traffic during outages (configured as temporary measure)
Automated alerts to NimbusForge on-call + Redwood SE; runbook stored in Drive link
acceptance_criteria: Performance: p95 latency <250ms sustained for 48h at 10% canary traffic
Quality: intent accuracy within 4% of baseline (hosted trial)
